MISUSE OF DRUGS ACT
(Chapter 185)
MISUSE OF DRUGS (APPROVED INSTITUTIONS AND TREATMENT and REHABILITATION) REGULATIONS
APPOINTMENT OF SUPERVISion officers
N 2
G.N. No. S 187/1976
REVISED EDITION 1999
(1st July 1999)
The Minister for Home Affairs has appointed the following officers to be supervision officers under regulation 15(1) of the Misuse of Drugs (Approved Institutions and Treatment and Rehabilitation) Regulations (Rg 3):
(1)All special officers of the Special Constabulary for so long as they are attached to the Aftercare Unit of the Special Constabulary;
[S 187/76 — 17.9.76]
(2)All Guard Commanders, Battalion Orderly Sergeants and Duty Officers of the Singapore Armed Forces while on duty;
(3)All officers of the Central Narcotics Bureau appointed under section 3 of the Act (Cap. 185);
(4)All police officers and members of the Vigilante Corps and the Special Constabulary attached to the Anti-Drug Units of all Police Divisions;
[S 4/78 — 1.1.78]
(5)All police officers and members of the Special Constabulary attached to the Supervision Division of the Central Narcotics Bureau;
[S 15/79 — 1.7.78]
(6)All police officers attached to the Police National Service (Full-time) Command Drug Supervision Unit;
[S 46/79 — 13.2.79]
(7)All members of the Vigilante Corps attached to the Supervision Division of the Central Narcotics Bureau; and
[S 248/79 — 1.11.79]
(8)Every person on the staff of the Singapore Armed Forces Counselling Centre.
[S 253/82 — 28.8.82]
